pain_points.name: Cart Abandonment
pain_points.description: Shoppers add items to cart but leave without completing purchase
pain_points.impact: 70.2% of carts are abandoned (73-78% on mobile), representing EUR 260 billion in recoverable revenue across US and EU
pain_points.ai_potential: AI-powered multi-channel recovery campaigns can recapture 10-15% of abandoned carts; advanced tools (Markopolo) claim 30-40% on high-value carts

pain_points.name: Rising Customer Acquisition Cost
pain_points.description: Cost to acquire new customers through paid channels continues to increase
pain_points.impact: Average ecommerce CAC is EUR 252; paid social EUR 1,012; Google Ads EUR 1,104. Up 40% in 2 years.
pain_points.current_solutions: Diversifying channels, organic content, referral programs
pain_points.ai_potential: AI audience targeting, lookalike modeling, and creative optimization can improve ROAS by 15-30%. Organic SEO delivers 2x better lead quality at lower CAC.

pain_points.name: Customer Service Overload
pain_points.description: High volume of repetitive inquiries about order status, shipping, returns
pain_points.impact: 60-70% of support tickets are repetitive; human cost EUR 5.52-36.80 per interaction vs EUR 0.46 for AI
pain_points.current_solutions: FAQ pages, basic chatbots, support team scaling
pain_points.ai_potential: AI chatbots handle 40-60% of inquiries automatically. 80% adoption among CS teams in 2026. Reduces cost per interaction by 12x.

pain_points.name: Inventory Mismanagement
pain_points.description: Stockouts on popular items while overstocking slow-movers ties up capital
pain_points.impact: Global retailers lose $1.7 trillion annually to combined stockouts and overstock. Stockouts cause 4-8% revenue loss.
pain_points.current_solutions: Manual spreadsheets, basic reorder points, gut feeling
pain_points.ai_potential: AI demand forecasting reduces errors by 20-50%, cuts lost sales by up to 65%, and reduces inventory holdings by 20-30%

pain_points.name: EU Regulatory Compliance Burden
pain_points.description: Multiple overlapping EU regulations requiring compliance: AI Act, DSA, EAA, GDPR, VAT reform, Right to Repair, Digital Product Passport
pain_points.impact: Non-compliance penalties up to EUR 35M or 7% global turnover (AI Act); EUR 500K per infringement (EAA). Enforcement is active.
pain_points.current_solutions: Manual compliance efforts, basic legal review
pain_points.ai_potential: Automated compliance scanning, consent management, accessibility testing, and documentation generation. Cookie consent, DSA transparency reports, and warranty labels are highly automatable.

key_metrics.name: Website Conversion Rate
key_metrics.description: Percentage of website visitors who complete a purchase
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Optimize checkout, improve product pages, personalized recommendations, A/B testing, AI search

key_metrics.name: Average Order Value (AOV)
key_metrics.benchmark: EUR 90 overall, EUR 144 EMEA average. Varies by niche: fashion EUR 60-150, electronics EUR 165-220
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Bundles, upsells (Rebuy), cross-sells, free shipping thresholds, loyalty programs

key_metrics.name: Customer Lifetime Value (CLV)
key_metrics.description: Total revenue expected from a customer over their lifetime
key_metrics.benchmark: Should be 3x+ customer acquisition cost. Overall EUR 92-276; omnichannel customers +30% higher CLV
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Retention marketing, subscription models, loyalty programs, post-purchase engagement, personalization (2-3x CLV uplift)

key_metrics.name: Cart Abandonment Rate
key_metrics.description: Percentage of shoppers who add items to cart but don't complete purchase
key_metrics.benchmark: <60% is good, 70.2% is average, >75% needs improvement. Mobile abandonment 73-78%.
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Simplify checkout, offer guest checkout (GDPR recommends this), abandoned cart emails, transparent pricing, reduce extra costs

key_metrics.name: Return Rate
key_metrics.description: Percentage of orders that are returned
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Better product photos, accurate descriptions, size guides, AR try-on tools (reduce returns 15-25%), exchange-first policies

key_metrics.name: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
key_metrics.description: Total cost to acquire a new customer
key_metrics.benchmark: EUR 252 average. Organic SEO EUR 595, email EUR 469, paid social EUR 1,012, Google Ads EUR 1,104
key_metrics.how_to_improve: Invest in organic/SEO (2x better lead quality), referral programs (lowest CAC), first-party data strategy, AI ad optimization
